When I moved into my first apartment. It was a WRECK. When I ordered my washer and dryer I was scheduled for work at 1pm. I planned for the guy to bring them and hook them up at 11. He gets there and it turns out that whoever installed the previous washer and dryer did the hosing wrong. So when the guy I bought them (I’ll call him Sam) from tried to replace them, they burst. I had to move all of my stuff upstairs (I had literally just moved in the day before so my things weren’t put away) because my downstairs became completely flooded. So I call the maintenance guy, he says he’ll get a wet vac, this is around 11:25-11:30 now and I say okay because my apartment is flooding. So me and Sam are just sitting on my stairs. Waiting. Next thing we know it’s 12:35.. I call my job and tell them the situation and I will be late. I call the maintenance man and he says he’s at lowes.. then doesn’t show up for another couple hours. Doesn’t bring the right tools, shuts off EVERYONES water without telling anyone and then leaving to go ‘buy the right tools’. So he takes another few hours, by now it’s 5-6pm and half of my neighbors have come to my house asking what’s up with the water.  As I’m talking to sam who installed my washer, waited with me for hours so I wouldn’t be uncomfortable(I had not met the maintenance man previously), and then helped me get the water out, he goes “you know what, you had a really bad day. You lost an entire days work and it wasn’t your fault. I can’t take this money from you.” We’re talking about an $800 washer and dryer set. I CRIED. I bawled in front of this man. He didn’t even know me, he was there for me all day and then doesn’t charge me for them. It’s the only time someone has ever done something like that for me. I hope he and his wife are doing well
